blockers.detail: Neither local Python torch nor compiled mmcv ops are available. Official torch versions differ between the two projects; use isolated environments and freeze a working version set, not the active H3/R_phi venv.

Compile/import MMCV against chosen torch/torch_npu/CANN versions and test actual 3x3, groups=1, deform_groups=24, offsets/mask including boundaries against CPU/CUDA. Do not replace DCN with ordinary convolution.
Both require flow warping/grid_sample; FaverNet additionally computes complex torch.fft.fft2 then roll/abs. Validate supported dtype/layout and outputs with actual target shapes.

FaverNet switches CPU cache on T>100 regardless of device then calls .cuda(); AverNet uses .cuda() only in its is_cuda cache branch, leaving NPU cache disabled. First adapter rejects >100 frames. No long-video or memory claim yet.

FaverNet test auto-selects CUDA or CPU, no NPU selector. AverNet framework validation allocates CUDA metrics even with CPU config; direct model adapter avoids this wrapper. Ascend remains a separate explicitly tested adapter task.
